name: walk_cane
text: A person walks forward with a cane in the right hand. The right leg is healthy and the left leg needs support. The cane and left foot advance together, then stay planted while the right leg steps through. Repeat this slow steady walking rhythm, keep holding the cane, no turning or stopping.
